stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Desktop 2.8.2 fixes entry expanded-role eligibility. Explicit Junior/Student/Intern/Trainee/Graduate titles use a candidate skills-fit floor of 10; regular expanded roles retain 12. The expanded APPLY score stays 70, with strong evidence, independent data signals, experience and location checks still required. A synthetic regression matching the logged Junior Data & Credit Reporting Specialist shape (76/100, five signals, skills fit 10) now reaches APPLY; the regular title remains REVIEW. Ranking logs and Dashboard details show skills fit, the applicable floor and failed automatic APPLY checks. Local vacancy snapshots preserve the diagnostics and CSV reasons retain full scoring/location explanations. The release pipeline runs 16 offline regression tests before building and preserves test sources. Jobs.cz, Prace.cz and StartupJobs.cz discovery, duplicate-submission protection and manual final Submit in Desktop are unchanged.
